name: Marginalia
author: Sajjad Heydari
description: A hidden context menu on cards, verbs, aspects and the board. Alt + right-click to write in the margins.
description_long: Hold Alt and right-click any card, verb, aspect icon, or open verb/card/aspect window to open a hidden context menu. Write a persistent note for any element or verb, shared across all your saves, or Alt + right-click the bare table to write a label on the board itself (Alt + drag to move it). Notes and labels are kept in marginalia.json and marginalia_board.json next to your save files. The modifier can be changed by adding marginalia_modifier=ctrl (or shift) to config.ini.
